purpose: Show why receptor-input removal, whole-cell clamping and output disconnection cannot be substituted in the next physiological receiver implementation.
status: Prospective deterministic mathematical witness, not fitted Dm9 simulation or biological data reanalysis
units: All states, drive and time are dimensionless engineering choices
frozenLearning: No learning or refitting occurs; all unmanipulated coefficients remain identical.
initialization: Intact/receptor-removed/output-disconnected/restored start at P0,D0. Cell clamp is established before the input, starting at P0-c*delta,D0-delta.
tests: clamp and output-cut have distinct absolute states
matched baseline subtraction makes their P traces identical under the stated affine assumptions
perturbing one saved point must fail numerical comparison
